openings.claim: Use a manifest-ordered boundary ledger to identify the earliest supported digest mismatch, retaining unresolved intervals wherever earlier boundaries lack comparable evidence.
openings.delta: Change the ordering dependency from local timestamps to manifest stage order, and carry each conclusion through record identifiers, compared digests and explicit coverage gaps. Nearest rival: timestamp-first digest scanning.
openings.prediction: If the anomalous pair has both parse and export mismatches, manifest ordering selects parse while timestamp-first scanning selects export. If earlier transform evidence is missing, the ledger reports an unresolved interval ending at the supported export mismatch; missing records never establish nonexecution. These predictions are conditional, not additional observations.
openings.probe: Build one shared evidence ledger with at most twelve manual record inspections per pair, prioritizing matched artifact boundaries and the anomalous parse/export records. Run both ordering variants on the same inspected evidence in each disjoint three-pair subset. Freeze all six reports, references, coverage gaps, next checks and inspection counts; then open the sealed answer sheets. During final review remove the stipulated transform records and recompute affected reports. Compare supported-stage accuracy and interval coverage, treating wider intervals as uncertainty rather than automatic failure.
assumptions: The manifest defines intended stage order; it does not prove execution or causal precedence.
Comparable digests refer to the same artifact boundary; unmatched boundaries remain unresolved.
Defeat conditions: manifest misalignment, insufficient comparable evidence, or identical variant decisions. A tie supplies no demonstrated advantage.

Capacity condition: ledger construction fits sixty analyst minutes and variant comparison twenty additional minutes. Uninspected records remain gaps if either allowance is exhausted; informative contrast requires a discordant ordering decision or disturbance-sensitive interval.
No guaranteed accuracy or time saving is inferred. Next checks use remaining inspection capacity or supplied manifest/dictionary checks; exhausted capacity is explicitly reported.

assessment: One hypothetical workflow opening. Record order, byte mismatches and explanatory causes remain separate. No actual pair records or answer sheets were provided here, so no divergence stage or measured effect is claimed.
